about: What plaincheck.py looks for: the rules of ../forge-design/plain.md that a page's HTML shows by itself. A label is matched as a whole in lower case (after trimming punctuation and arrows), jargon as whole words in any case, leaks (programming values) as whole words in their exact case, all in the visible text. English and Dutch.

vague_label.title: A button or link that does not say what it does
vague_label.why: "Verzenden", "OK" or "Klik hier" make a person guess what happens; plain.md rule 1
vague_label.fix: say the action and the thing: "Afspraak maken", "Bestelling plaatsen", "Bekijk de prijzen"

icon_only.title: A button or link with only an icon
icon_only.why: an icon alone (a bin, three dots, a hamburger) is a riddle for many people; an aria-label helps screen readers, not eyes; plain.md rule 3
icon_only.fix: show a word next to the icon: "Verwijderen", "Menu", "Meer opties"

placeholder_label.title: A field without a visible label
placeholder_label.why: a placeholder disappears while typing and an aria-label is never seen, so the person forgets what the field was for; plain.md rule 4
placeholder_label.fix: a <label for=...> above the field that stays visible; keep a placeholder only for an example

jargon.title: Technical words on the page
jargon.why: words like "authenticatie", "sessie" or "invalid input" mean nothing to most people; plain.md rule 5
jargon.fix: say what happened and what to do, in the user's words (plain.md, Words)

leak.title: A programming value shows on the page
leak.why: "undefined", "NaN" or "[object Object]" on a screen is a bug that a visitor sees
leak.fix: find where the value is built and show a real value or a sentence instead

long_form.title: A long form in one go
long_form.why: many fields at once tire people and make them give up; plain.md rule 8
long_form.fix: split it in steps of 5 or 6 fields with "Stap 2 van 3" and a bar, or drop the fields that are not needed

tone.title: An unprofessional tone
tone.why: exclamation marks, jokes, emoji or words like "simpelweg" make an app sound childish or talk down to people; plain.md rule 16
tone.fix: say the fact calmly and exactly: "Uw afspraak staat op 3 mei om 14:00."

long_menu.title: A menu with many items
long_menu.why: more than 7 choices at once is hard to scan; plain.md rule 13
long_menu.fix: keep 5 main items and put the rest under one of them, or in a page of its own
